title: myCount — time counter to a date
lifeGridOpenCounter: Open a countdown to this date
lifeGridHint: Each cell is one week, month, or day of life. Filled cells are already lived. Click a cell to see its date.
lifeGridMarksHint: Dots: birthdays; larger dots mark ages 10, 20, 30…. In months mode only round ages are marked.
lifeGridDaysHint: Days mode works best in fullscreen.
betweenOpenCounter: Open a countdown to the second date
betweenHint: Calendar days only: the difference is full midnights between the two dates.
introTitle: How many seconds until a given date?
introText: Enter a date and time below. myCount shows the remaining time in seconds, minutes, hours, days, and more.
tzLocalHint: Time is in your local zone
tzHint: The date and time above happen in this timezone. Everyone who opens the link reaches zero at the same moment, wherever they are. If you want each visitor to count to this date on their own clock, pick the "recipient's local time" option in the settings below.
lifeHint: Round numbers: when the counter will show exactly this many seconds, minutes, hours… Click a row to switch the counter to that unit. The arrows browse more values, and the search finds the moment for your own number.
linkHint: «Short link» gives …/s/XXXXXX with a Telegram preview. Old long links keep working as before.
shareInstantHint: Everyone hits zero at the same moment worldwide (classic t link).
shareLocalTemplate: Until {date} in the recipient's local time
shareLocalHint: Each person counts to that date and time in their own timezone. Below — «every year» or a one-time date.
shareOnceHint: Unchecked = one-time date: once it passes, the counter flips to time elapsed.
textLimitHint: Up to {n} characters — the text goes into the link and the preview card.
eventsHint: Use arrows to browse — past dates show elapsed time, future dates show time remaining.
messengerLinkHint: Preview shows the event title (Telegram, etc.).
counterClickHint: Click to switch the time unit
restClickHint: Click to switch the remainder style: decimal fraction or time units
